# UI Layout Checklist: Runner Result Rows Never Overlap When Expanded

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements — layout, list sizing, scroll/overflow, keyboard
access, live updates, and scope/regression boundaries — run before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` (focus: ui-layout; depth: standard; audience: PR
reviewer) and then run against spec.md, plan.md and contracts/. Every item was evaluated; items
that failed on first read were fixed in the artifacts (noted inline) before being ticked.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all parts of the expanded row and their order specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — error → tests → script errors → console, each "if any" except tests.
- [x] CHK002 Is the height behaviour specified both below and above the cap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, US1 scenarios 3–4] — grows to content below 320 px, scrolls past it; no empty band for short content.
- [x] CHK003 Are the placement requirements for items *below* an expanded row defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are the triggers that must re-place the list enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — expand/collapse, content change, width change.
- [x] CHK005 Is the expanded state's persistence across live refreshes and filter changes specified? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases] — *failed on first read; added the edge case "Rows the user expanded stay expanded…".*
- [x] CHK006 Are keyboard-access requirements defined for the capped, scrollable panel? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the "sensible maximum" from the issue quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications] — 320 px, decided by the product owner.
- [x] CHK008 Is it unambiguous what box the 320 px cap measures? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — the panel's outer box, padding included, bottom margin excluded.
- [x] CHK009 Is the cap's unit defined relative to UI zoom? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — *failed on first read; added "in UI pixels, so View → Zoom scales it" (zoom exists: `frontend/src/app/zoom.ts`).*
- [x] CHK010 Is "no shrinking" stated without a double negative? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — rephrased to "MUST NOT shrink" during analyze.
- [x] CHK011 Is the accessible name of the panel specified exactly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009] — "Details of <row name>", the chevron's name.
- [x] CHK012 Is the horizontal overflow behaviour of long console lines specified? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases] — wrap; an unbreakable token scrolls sideways inside the panel.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the collapsed-row and heading heights agree across spec, data model and contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, data-model.md, contracts/layout-contract.md] — 32 px and 28 px in all three.
- [x] CHK014 Does the cap value agree across spec, plan, data model, contract and tasks? [Consistency] — 320 px everywhere.
- [x] CHK015 Is the panel's tab-order position consistent between FR-009 and the contract? [Consistency, contracts/layout-contract.md] — chevron → name → panel → controls inside the panel.
- [x] CHK016 Is FR-008 (response viewer unchanged) consistent with the plan's choice not to edit `TestResultsTab`? [Consistency, plan.md Design, research R4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can "no overlap" be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, SC-002] — 0 overlapping lines; items start within 1 px of the previous end.
- [x] CHK018 Is "look as they do today" for collapsed lists measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — same row/heading heights (32/28 px).
- [x] CHK019 Is the keyboard outcome measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] — reach the panel and scroll to its last line with the keyboard only.
- [x] CHK020 Does every FR map to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability, plan.md coverage map] — FR-001–FR-009 all mapped.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for several rows expanded at once? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenario 2, FR-006]
- [x] CHK022 Are live-run scenarios (rows arriving, expanded row's content changing) covered? [Coverage, Spec §US3 scenarios 1–2]
- [x] CHK023 Is the past-run-from-Runs scenario covered? [Coverage, Spec §US3 scenario 3]
- [x] CHK024 Are results-filter and tests-filter changes covered? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenario 3, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Is the narrower list (row detail side panel open) covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Is the zero-tests case defined so it neither stretches nor is squeezed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Are long multi-line test messages addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 Is the wheel/trackpad hand-off at the panel's top/bottom defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — *failed on first read; added the edge case "…further scrolling moves the Results list itself".*
- [x] CHK029 Is the behaviour defined for a focused panel that leaves the rendered part of the virtualized list? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — *failed on first read; added: loses focus as the row's buttons do today, no restoration added.*
- [x] CHK030 Is the behaviour defined when rows above the viewport change height? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications] — view stays in place; no auto-scroll.
- [x] CHK031 Is the performance-run case (no row list) bounded? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK032 Is the focus indicator requirement specified? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-009] — the app's focus ring.
- [x] CHK033 Are the platforms covered and how each is verified specified? [Cross-platform, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications] — macOS by eye; Windows/Linux through CI.
- [x] CHK034 Are performance expectations for a large or live run stated? [Performance, plan.md Technical Context] — sizes come from the list's existing observer; items re-placed only when a size changes; the 10,000-row virtualization case stays green (T007).
- [x] CHK035 Are secrets/data-handling impacts addressed? [Security, plan.md Constitution II] — none: console lines are shown exactly as today.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Is the "frontend-only" assumption validated against the code? [Assumption, research R1] — the defect is in `RunResults.tsx`/`.module.css` only; no Go code involved.
- [x] CHK037 Is the reliance on the list library's measuring and scroll anchoring validated rather than assumed? [Dependency, research R2] — verified in `@tanstack/virtual-core` 3.14.14 source.
- [x] CHK038 Is the absence of a Godog scenario justified under the constitution? [Constitution V, plan.md Complexity Tracking]

## Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK039 Are the out-of-scope items explicit? [Scope, Spec §FR-007, Context] — the row detail side panel, what the expansion shows, performance results.
- [x] CHK040 Is the regression boundary for shared components stated? [Scope, Spec §FR-008, contracts/layout-contract.md "Unchanged"] — `TestResultsTab`, `runner-slots.tsx`, `RunRowDetail`, `PerformanceResults`.
